rows.medi_said: I think I gotta take that off. Enbas... Oh, I put enbustee. I put enbustee.
rows.amal_said: "انبسطتي." ... Yes, it is double T.
rows.why: Homework 'Did you enjoy your time outside?': he wrote/said انبسطي (command form, no -t) for the past you-fem انبسطتي; Amal recast انبسطتي and confirmed 'it is double T', he admitted 'I just forgot the double T'.

rows.medi_said: Did you enjoy, past tense, your time outside? Okay, so isn't it en-enbistee?
rows.amal_said: what is missing? It's not "انبسطتي." Something is missing. What is it? ... "في" or be?
rows.why: انبسط takes في / بـ before its object; his homework sentence had no preposition, Amal prompted 'what is missing?' and he found في (06:50 'I totally forgot about the fee'), she confirmed 'في or be'.
rows.english: Did you enjoy your time outside?

rows.medi_said: Yeah, انبسط didn't I?

rows.medi_said: التخييم بسط ... كل حدا و حَمَس
rows.amal_said: Let's put the verbs together. ... بسط وحمس
rows.why: He split the two verbs around the object (made everyone happy and excited); Amal told him to put the verbs together (بسط وحمس) before the object.
rows.english: Camping made everyone happy and excited

rows.medi_said: كل الناس؟
rows.amal_said: كل حدا or what's everyone? ... الكل.

rows.medi_said: ليل

It's just ما تزعجني', 51:22) until 51:32 ما تزعجيني; one row at the first wrong repeat; the عين stress part is pronunciation.
